bullets.text: GPT-5.2 Revolutionizes Enterprise AI - **Microsoft Foundry** introduces advanced reasoning and compliance-ready features for enterprise developers.
Windows Terminal Gets Smarter - **GitHub Copilot CLI** enhances terminal experience, allowing developers to optimize workflows directly.
Personalize Your PC - New **Themes** department in the **Microsoft Store** offers over 400 customizable themes for Windows devices.
AI-Powered Azure Storage - **Azure Blob Storage** evolves to support the entire AI lifecycle, enhancing data management capabilities.
GPT-5.2 Now in Microsoft 365 - **Microsoft 365 Copilot** integrates GPT-5.2 for improved insights and strategic planning.
Cybersecurity Threats Evolve - **Microsoft** reveals tactics used by cybercriminals posing as employees to gain access.
Insights from Microsoft Ignite - Key announcements from **Microsoft Ignite 2025** focus on cloud and AI innovations.
Building a Security-First Culture - **Microsoft** emphasizes the importance of cybersecurity in the age of AI.
Email Security Benchmarking - **Microsoft** releases insights on email security performance amid growing threats.
Windows 11 Insider Preview Update - New features and improvements are rolling out for **Windows 11 Insiders**.
